Authoring discipline added: headline + brand chrome must stay inside central 1080×1350 IG-safe zone. v0.4.4: 5-act narrative spine HOOK → FORESHADOW → BODY → PEAK → CTA + nyentrik mandate on both HOOK and CTA. v0.4.3: top-level caption + hashtags + link_comment with 4 schema invariants. Pure content generation — emits draft JSON for an admin panel to consume.
